overview: Biochemists and biophysicists study the chemistry and physics of living things: how cells, proteins, DNA and drugs work at the molecular level. They design experiments, analyze data, publish findings and often teach or supervise students. O*NET rates science at 4.75 out of 5 for this job and their investigative interest at a maximum 7.00. Most research roles need a PhD, and O*NET places the job in Job Zone 5. The BLS May 2025 median is $127,410 across 33,830 jobs, many in biotech and pharmaceutical companies. Long weeks are common, but much of the work is independent.
pay: Biochemists and biophysicists earn a median of $127,410, and the top 10% earn $201,110 or more. Massachusetts, home of a large biotech cluster, has by far the most jobs, 14,890, at a median of $131,600. Florida has the highest state median at $157,390, 24% above the national figure.

faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median for biochemists and biophysicists is $127,410 a year. The middle half earn between $95,000 and $163,460, and the lowest 10% earn under $74,290. Florida, California ($139,580) and Tennessee ($134,560) have the highest state medians, while Alabama has the lowest at $48,510.

faq.q: What degree do you need to be a biochemist?
faq.a: Most independent research jobs need a PhD in biochemistry, biophysics or a related field, and O*NET places the job in Job Zone 5. A bachelor's degree, held by 25% in O*NET data, can lead to lab technician roles. There are 9 related majors, including molecular biochemistry.

O*NET rates science at 4.75 out of 5 for this job, and reading comprehension at 4.38. Critical thinking and writing are both rated 4.25, since grant proposals and journal articles are a big part of the work. Knowledge of biology is rated 4.65 and chemistry 4.35.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to biochemist?
faq.a: The closest moves are Physicists (86% match), Nanosystems Engineers (85%) and Bioengineers and Biomedical Engineers (80%), based on O*NET 31.0. Physicists earn $172,250, 35% more, and Astronomers, a 77% match, earn $128,820, according to BLS May 2025 data.
